csv_scope_of_work: South Bass Island State Park boat launch - Design improvements to launch ramp, protective pier, and adjacent shoreline to improve safety, accessibility, and operational capacity. Develop alternatives for widening the ramp to accommodate two simultaneous launch lanes and recommend an optimal courtesy dock configuration that best serves either a single or dual lane layout. East Harbor State Park campground and marina boat launch - Campground launch- design improvements to both launch lanes, evaluate the courtesy docks for repair or replacement, and provide a visual assessment of the adjacent seawall. Marina launch- design a full replacement of the ramp and assess the abutments for potential repair or replacement. (not including the adjacent boat lift or well)
